title: Issue #4717 (P4 keystone of #4707): split the Evaluator into a shared read-mostly core (code/IR, prim table, interned symbols, JIT code cache, promoted old space) and a per-body EvalContext (fiber Context: self-TCO stamp, eval depth, try depth, file-diag root/resume form); the whole-body mutex shrinks to a narrow CLI-main commit lock and bodies run concurrently.
ok: OK: Issue #4717 evaluator split - the thread-backend body no longer takes the CLI body mutex, per-body execution state lives in the fiber Context, and AC13 (#4720) observes two CPU-bound bodies runnable in one sample (the two-body ThreadSanitizer run is clean for this surface; the remaining string-heap report is #4714b)
